description: A color theme for the Vela IRC client. See docs/THEMES.md.

colors.description: Token colors. Anything left out is derived from the other tokens.

accent.description:
The theme's accent: selection, badges, buttons, focus rings.

Default: #C792EA (dark), #39ADB5 (light)

accentForeground.description:
Text and icons drawn on accent-colored fills.

Default: contrast(accent)

accentText.description:
The accent when used as text or thin lines on chat.background (links, your nick, mentions). Set it when accent is too light or dark to read.

Default: accent (dark), mix(accent, #000000, 36%) (light)

button.hoverBackground.description:
Primary button under the pointer.

Default: mix(button.background, #FFFFFF, 12%) (dark), mix(button.background, #000000, 10%) (light)

button.secondaryBackground.description:
Secondary button.

Default: mix(window.background, window.foreground, 12%) (dark), mix(window.background, window.foreground, 8%) (light)

chat.codeBackground.description:
Background of inline code and preformatted text.

Default: mix(chat.background, chat.foreground, 7.0%) (dark), mix(chat.background, chat.foreground, 5%) (light)

chat.codeForeground.description:
Inline code and preformatted text.

Default: chat.foreground

chat.dayDivider.description:
Line separating days.

Default: mix(chat.background, chat.foreground, 12%)

chat.dayDividerForeground.description:
Date label on the day divider.

Default: chat.secondaryForeground

chat.error.description:
Errors shown in the conversation.

Default: status.error

chat.event.description:
Membership and state events (joins, parts, modes…) unless a more specific token is set.

Default: chat.secondaryForeground

chat.findMatchBackground.description:
Matches when searching the conversation. Usually translucent.

Default: transparent(status.warning, 35%)

chat.foreground.description:
Message text. Keep at least 4.5:1 contrast with chat.background.

Default: window.foreground

chat.highlightBackground.description:
Background of messages that mention you.

Default: mix(chat.background, chat.highlightBorder, 12%) (dark), mix(chat.background, chat.highlightBorder, 10%) (light)

chat.highlightBorder.description:
Bar along the edge of messages that mention you.

Default: chat.mention

chat.hoverBackground.description:
Message under the pointer. Usually translucent.

Default: transparent(chat.foreground, 4%)

chat.mention.description:
Your nickname where it's mentioned in message text.

Default: accentText

chat.secondaryForeground.description:
Secondary conversation text such as hostnames and metadata.

Default: mix(chat.foreground, chat.background, 35%)

chat.selectionBackground.description:
Selected text and selected messages. Usually translucent.

Default: transparent(accent, 30%) (dark), transparent(accent, 25%) (light)

chat.selfMessageBackground.description:
Background behind your own messages.

Default: chat.background

chat.selfNick.description:
Your own nickname on your messages.

Default: accentText

chat.serverMessage.description:
Server messages: MOTD, numerics, connection progress.

Default: chat.secondaryForeground

chat.unreadMarker.description:
Line and label marking the first unread message.

Default: accent

embed.accent.description:
Bar along the edge of a link preview.

Default: accent

embed.background.description:
Link preview card background.

Default: mix(chat.background, chat.foreground, 4%) (dark), mix(chat.background, chat.foreground, 3%) (light)

embed.border.description:
Link preview card border.

Default: mix(chat.background, chat.foreground, 12%)

embed.description.description:
Link preview description.

Default: mix(chat.foreground, embed.background, 15%)

embed.placeholderBackground.description:
Placeholder shown while an image or video loads.

Default: mix(embed.background, chat.foreground, 6%)

embed.siteName.description:
Site name above the link preview title.

Default: chat.secondaryForeground

focusBorder.description:
Focus ring of focused controls.

Default: accent

input.background.description:
The message field.

Default: mix(input.containerBackground, chat.foreground, 6%) (dark), mix(input.containerBackground, #FFFFFF, 70%) (light)

input.border.description:
Border of the message field.

Default: mix(input.background, input.foreground, 12%) (dark), mix(input.background, input.foreground, 15%) (light)

input.containerBackground.description:
The bar around the message field.

Default: chat.background

input.focusBorder.description:
Border of the message field while it has focus.

Default: focusBorder

input.foreground.description:
Text typed in the message field.

Default: chat.foreground

input.iconForeground.description:
Buttons and icons inside the composer.

Default: mix(input.foreground, input.background, 35%)

input.placeholder.description:
Placeholder text in the empty message field.

Default: mix(input.foreground, input.background, 50%) (dark), mix(input.foreground, input.background, 42%) (light)

memberList.awayForeground.description:
Members who are away.

Default: mix(memberList.foreground, memberList.background, 45%) (dark), mix(memberList.foreground, memberList.background, 36%) (light)

memberList.border.description:
Edge between the member list and the conversation.

Default: pane.divider

memberList.foreground.description:
Member nicknames (when nick colors are off).

Default: sidebar.foreground

memberList.headerForeground.description:
Group headers such as “Operators” and member counts.

Default: sidebar.headerForeground

memberList.hoverBackground.description:
Row under the pointer.

Default: sidebar.hoverBackground

memberList.prefixForeground.description:
Mode prefixes (~ & @ % +) before nicknames.

Default: memberList.headerForeground

pane.divider.description:
Dividers between the sidebar, conversation and member list.

Default: mix(window.background, #000000, 30%) (dark), mix(window.background, window.foreground, 12%) (light)

popover.background.description:
Popovers, autocomplete lists and tooltips drawn by Vela.

Default: mix(window.background, #FFFFFF, 5%) (dark), mix(window.background, #FFFFFF, 80%) (light)

rail.activeBackground.description:
Selected item in the collapsed sidebar.

Default: sidebar.activeBackground

rail.activeIndicator.description:
Indicator bar next to the selected item.

Default: accent

rail.background.description:
Background of the collapsed sidebar.

Default: sidebar.background

rail.badgeBackground.description:
Activity badge in the collapsed sidebar.

Default: sidebar.highlightBadgeBackground

rail.badgeForeground.description:
Text of the activity badge.

Default: sidebar.highlightBadgeForeground

rail.border.description:
Edge of the collapsed sidebar.

Default: sidebar.border

rail.foreground.description:
Icons and initials in the collapsed sidebar.

Default: sidebar.foreground

rail.inactiveForeground.description:
Icons of disconnected or idle networks in the collapsed sidebar.

Default: sidebar.secondaryForeground

reaction.border.description:
Reaction pill border.

Default: mix(chat.background, chat.foreground, 12%)

reaction.selfBackground.description:
Reaction pill you've added.

Default: mix(chat.background, accent, 18%) (dark), mix(chat.background, accent, 14.0%) (light)

reaction.selfBorder.description:
Border of a reaction pill you've added.

Default: mix(chat.background, accent, 60%)

reply.background.description:
Background of the quoted message in a reply.

Default: transparent(chat.background, 0%)

reply.foreground.description:
Quoted message text in a reply.

Default: chat.secondaryForeground

reply.quoteBar.description:
Bar beside the quoted message a reply refers to.

Default: mix(chat.background, chat.foreground, 25%)

scrollbar.thumbHover.description:
Scrollbar thumb under the pointer.

Default: transparent(window.foreground, 35%)

settings.background.description:
Settings window content background.

Default: window.background

settings.controlBackground.description:
Text fields and grouped rows in Settings.

Default: input.background

settings.foreground.description:
Settings labels and text.

Default: window.foreground

settings.secondaryForeground.description:
Settings help text and captions.

Default: mix(settings.foreground, settings.background, 40%) (dark), mix(settings.foreground, settings.background, 33%) (light)

sidebar.activeBackground.description:
The selected channel or query.

Default: mix(sidebar.background, accent, 22%) (dark), mix(sidebar.background, accent, 18%) (light)

sidebar.activeForeground.description:
Text of the selected channel or query.

Default: sidebar.unreadForeground

sidebar.background.description:
Sidebar background. Usually a slight tint of window.background.

Default: mix(window.background, #000000, 16%) (dark), mix(window.background, window.foreground, 4.5%) (light)

sidebar.badgeForeground.description:
Text of the unread-count badge.

Default: sidebar.unreadForeground

sidebar.border.description:
Edge between the sidebar and the conversation.

Default: pane.divider

sidebar.disconnectedForeground.description:
Networks and channels while disconnected.

Default: mix(sidebar.foreground, sidebar.background, 50%)

sidebar.foreground.description:
Names of channels and queries with no unread activity, and general sidebar text.

Default: mix(window.foreground, sidebar.background, 20%) (dark), mix(window.foreground, sidebar.background, 15%) (light)

sidebar.headerForeground.description:
Section and network headers.

Default: mix(sidebar.foreground, sidebar.background, 30%) (dark), mix(sidebar.foreground, sidebar.background, 22%) (light)

sidebar.highlightBadgeBackground.description:
Badge counting unread mentions of you.

Default: accent

sidebar.highlightBadgeForeground.description:
Text of the mention badge.

Default: accentForeground

sidebar.highlightForeground.description:
Names of channels and queries with unread mentions of you.

Default: accentText

sidebar.hoverBackground.description:
Row under the pointer.

Default: transparent(sidebar.foreground, 7.0%)

sidebar.secondaryForeground.description:
Secondary sidebar text: server names, counts, parted channels.

Default: mix(sidebar.foreground, sidebar.background, 40%) (dark), mix(sidebar.foreground, sidebar.background, 20%) (light)

sidebar.unreadForeground.description:
Names of channels and queries with unread messages.

Default: window.foreground

status.success.description:
Connected state and success messages.

Default: #C3E88D (dark), #3D7D1E (light)

tab.activeBackground.description:
Selected tab that opens into the conversation.

Default: chat.background

tab.activeForeground.description:
Text of the selected attached tab.

Default: chat.foreground

tab.activeIndicator.description:
Accent line on the selected tab.

Default: accent

tab.barBackground.description:
Strip behind the tabs.

Default: sidebar.background

tab.border.description:
Strip border and the outline of an attached tab.

Default: titleBar.border

tab.foreground.description:
Text of read tabs.

Default: sidebar.foreground

tab.groupBackground.description:
Segmented network group in the title bar.

Default: transparent(sidebar.foreground, 7.0%)

tab.highlightForeground.description:
Text of tabs with mentions.

Default: sidebar.highlightForeground

tab.inactiveForeground.description:
Muted, parted or offline tabs.

Default: sidebar.disconnectedForeground

tab.pillBackground.description:
Selected floating tab (title bar and pill shapes).

Default: sidebar.activeBackground

tab.pillForeground.description:
Text of a selected floating tab.

Default: sidebar.activeForeground

tab.serverActiveBackground.description:
Selected network in the server row.

Default: rail.activeBackground

tab.serverBackground.description:
Background of the server (network) row.

Default: rail.background

tab.unreadForeground.description:
Text of tabs with unread messages.

Default: sidebar.unreadForeground

titleBar.background.description:
Background of the title bar / toolbar above the conversation.

Default: chat.background

titleBar.border.description:
Line under the title bar.

Default: pane.divider

titleBar.foreground.description:
Channel name and toolbar icons.

Default: chat.foreground

titleBar.secondaryForeground.description:
Topic and other secondary title bar text.

Default: mix(titleBar.foreground, titleBar.background, 40%) (dark), mix(titleBar.foreground, titleBar.background, 33%) (light)

window.background.description:
Base background of the window. Most surfaces derive from it.

Default: #292D3E (dark), #FAFAFA (light)

window.border.description:
Outer window border and the edges of floating panels.

Default: pane.divider

window.foreground.description:
Base text color. Most text colors derive from it.

Default: #BFC7D5 (dark), #3E525C (light)

description.description: A short description shown in the theme picker.

include.description: Name or id of a theme to start from. This theme's values are layered on top of it.

ircColors.description: mIRC formatting colors by index (0–98). Only listed indexes change; 16–98 rarely need it.

name.description: Display name. Settings refer to themes by this name (case-insensitive) or by file name.

nickColors.description: Palette for nickname colors; each nick always gets the same entry. Replaces the default palette.

type.description: Whether the theme is dark or light. Picks token defaults and the appearance of system menus and alerts.

vibrancy.description: Use the system's translucent materials: none (opaque colors), sidebar (sidebar and rail) or window.

title: Vela theme
